# Foshan Sanshui Xiangfa Shun Plastic Co., Ltd.

Website: https://xfspvc.com/en/
Chinese site: https://xfspvc.com/

The company is based in Sanshui District, Foshan, Guangdong, China. This website describes PVC wire and cable compound categories, the inquiry workflow and contact details. Performance values, applicable standards, MOQ, sample timing and documents must be confirmed for each formulation and order.

## Products and procurement

- Product catalog: https://xfspvc.com/en/products/
- Manufacturing and trials: https://xfspvc.com/en/manufacturing/
- Selection guidance: https://xfspvc.com/en/knowledge/
- Buyer notes: https://xfspvc.com/en/updates/
- Inquiry worksheet: https://xfspvc.com/en/tools/inquiry/

Categories include PVC insulation, sheath, electronic wire and plug compounds, plus custom formulation discussions. A category name is not a certification claim. Share the application, target standard, color, hardness, processing conditions, expected volume and current sample for a product-specific technical discussion.
